description.value: The Brockton Point Totem Poles are a celebrated outdoor cultural site within Stanley Park, featuring a collection of monumental Indigenous poles representing First Nations from across British Columbia. The site sits along the Stanley Park Seawall, one of the most popular cycling routes in Vancouver, making it a natural stopping point for touring cyclists circumnavigating the park. As a free, open-air attraction on public parkland, it requires no admission and is accessible year-round.
